A **Kanban board** is `a visual productivity and workflow management tool that maps out tasks across columns to show how work moves from start to finish` . Originally created in the 1940s by Taiichi Ohno at Toyota to optimize manufacturing flow, the method is now widely used in software development, marketing, HR, and personal organization.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXXZS3bdrjEJ758PaxYUCXRACTRi_kIGKThTMy5bviw7goF0hF4H1pzqEwiDanyDZfUYmUHyXU3Dg3eU5Qj845xyPUZBcb7b_pqfXwjEkGJ04MwqnouI6WOCQUmf_zeHQaaBOc)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXmT5eU5jEcSO3iIPCAhcfZbP5ILT1E4ntOYJ2JbalRpYoyCqRZe7YamA7yMr8MPqiqnGsbpCEyPdJ3T4t-gbV49LmPTLa2e_-YSU9MwuG6KfxTC_ziS-aCugGvxOTezupqNfsdmANRYypwwQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXc9iT9z4c5xFzrN_AHwroylqxPMJgS3o0zMRJ_YubYVMxPltcjTrnaZs3PpOUF855QMV_uEFSXz58E22qaangfza5PIo_OGbwiNGvktSrzKe7anox_VzsB46q9BW-97ieuTRzY1i9J8BLono)



---

### Core Components

- **Columns:** Represent specific stages of your workflow (most commonly *To Do*, *Doing/In Progress* , and *Done* ), moving left to right.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXXZS3bdrjEJ758PaxYUCXRACTRi_kIGKThTMy5bviw7goF0hF4H1pzqEwiDanyDZfUYmUHyXU3Dg3eU5Qj845xyPUZBcb7b_pqfXwjEkGJ04MwqnouI6WOCQUmf_zeHQaaBOc)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXmT5eU5jEcSO3iIPCAhcfZbP5ILT1E4ntOYJ2JbalRpYoyCqRZe7YamA7yMr8MPqiqnGsbpCEyPdJ3T4t-gbV49LmPTLa2e_-YSU9MwuG6KfxTC_ziS-aCugGvxOTezupqNfsdmANRYypwwQ)
- **Kanban Cards:** Individual notes or digital tickets representing specific tasks, often containing assignees, due dates, and priority tags.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF15DYcFZnqS4glvj6klcgUajRmA9fTaTEa874LqIG_fJbAjZ6kvvjpq_fuZBEe5mDQ29R21pWjdwAK5wUWghfAmNw55k8l2tPEb6jCzjnt1upS9RD-BbaaeKZpx_2z3TykjAWuwnd6Mk8LHBtwqy2hNoOcbE8kA1HLgBxKA59rw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXXZS3bdrjEJ758PaxYUCXRACTRi_kIGKThTMy5bviw7goF0hF4H1pzqEwiDanyDZfUYmUHyXU3Dg3eU5Qj845xyPUZBcb7b_pqfXwjEkGJ04MwqnouI6WOCQUmf_zeHQaaBOc)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qp7Wc6ba_fc)
- **Work-In-Progress (WIP) Limits:** Caps on how many active tasks can occupy a single column at one time to prevent bottlenecks and multitasking overload.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXwJUaBF-v-lBh9AUyfCdtBQdp54jxi7fw0E_E8wfH6yUcsS2Gi9JrJwPN0qk9g9cYFMQS3VLA6Kn84vEcsFoykczI1sN9igH3ZxjJpKLhArMlIljzT8Bw5evXciW8uDlnefoVwQk)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHEIkXX7jfz22NO3FDyDZJ-ECepJhELr2CJUr4jrTkN9jy43YxiHumxPQRnPk-C_iGTQ0eyWZbXPaPJe32Kc8ZpNbXOcl4ivqzFVrRRIKDFEvld8OCtwWYi67ADDyNUqw)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qp7Wc6ba_fc)
- **Swimlanes:** Horizontal rows used to separate different teams, projects, or categories of work on the same board.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHEIkXX7jfz22NO3FDyDZJ-ECepJhELr2CJUr4jrTkN9jy43YxiHumxPQRnPk-C_iGTQ0eyWZbXPaPJe32Kc8ZpNbXOcl4ivqzFVrRRIKDFEvld8OCtwWYi67ADDyNUqw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXXZS3bdrjEJ758PaxYUCXRACTRi_kIGKThTMy5bviw7goF0hF4H1pzqEwiDanyDZfUYmUHyXU3Dg3eU5Qj845xyPUZBcb7b_pqfXwjEkGJ04MwqnouI6WOCQUmf_zeHQaaBOc)
- **Commitment and Delivery Points:** The moment a task is pulled into active work (*commitment* ) and when it is finished and delivered to the user or client (*delivery*).[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qp7Wc6ba_fc)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXwJUaBF-v-lBh9AUyfCdtBQdp54jxi7fw0E_E8wfH6yUcsS2Gi9JrJwPN0qk9g9cYFMQS3VLA6Kn84vEcsFoykczI1sN9igH3ZxjJpKLhArMlIljzT8Bw5evXciW8uDlnefoVwQk)



---

### How It Works

1. **Visualize Work:** Write down every task or project piece on a card and place it in the backlog or *To Do* column.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXXZS3bdrjEJ758PaxYUCXRACTRi_kIGKThTMy5bviw7goF0hF4H1pzqEwiDanyDZfUYmUHyXU3Dg3eU5Qj845xyPUZBcb7b_pqfXwjEkGJ04MwqnouI6WOCQUmf_zeHQaaBOc)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXmT5eU5jEcSO3iIPCAhcfZbP5ILT1E4ntOYJ2JbalRpYoyCqRZe7YamA7yMr8MPqiqnGsbpCEyPdJ3T4t-gbV49LmPTLa2e_-YSU9MwuG6KfxTC_ziS-aCugGvxOTezupqNfsdmANRYypwwQ)
2. **Limit Multitasking:** Set rules for how many items can be in *Doing* at once so team members finish current tasks before starting new ones.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXmT5eU5jEcSO3iIPCAhcfZbP5ILT1E4ntOYJ2JbalRpYoyCqRZe7YamA7yMr8MPqiqnGsbpCEyPdJ3T4t-gbV49LmPTLa2e_-YSU9MwuG6KfxTC_ziS-aCugGvxOTezupqNfsdmANRYypwwQ)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qp7Wc6ba_fc)
3. **Move Left to Right:** As a task progresses through production or review, slide its card across the columns until it reaches *Done*.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXXZS3bdrjEJ758PaxYUCXRACTRi_kIGKThTMy5bviw7goF0hF4H1pzqEwiDanyDZfUYmUHyXU3Dg3eU5Qj845xyPUZBcb7b_pqfXwjEkGJ04MwqnouI6WOCQUmf_zeHQaaBOc)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXmT5eU5jEcSO3iIPCAhcfZbP5ILT1E4ntOYJ2JbalRpYoyCqRZe7YamA7yMr8MPqiqnGsbpCEyPdJ3T4t-gbV49LmPTLa2e_-YSU9MwuG6KfxTC_ziS-aCugGvxOTezupqNfsdmANRYypwwQ)
4. **Inspect and Adapt:** Regularly review where cards stall (bottlenecks) and adjust workflow rules to improve speed and quality.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXXZS3bdrjEJ758PaxYUCXRACTRi_kIGKThTMy5bviw7goF0hF4H1pzqEwiDanyDZfUYmUHyXU3Dg3eU5Qj845xyPUZBcb7b_pqfXwjEkGJ04MwqnouI6WOCQUmf_zeHQaaBOc)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXwJUaBF-v-lBh9AUyfCdtBQdp54jxi7fw0E_E8wfH6yUcsS2Gi9JrJwPN0qk9g9cYFMQS3VLA6Kn84vEcsFoykczI1sN9igH3ZxjJpKLhArMlIljzT8Bw5evXciW8uDlnefoVwQk)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHEIkXX7jfz22NO3FDyDZJ-ECepJhELr2CJUr4jrTkN9jy43YxiHumxPQRnPk-C_iGTQ0eyWZbXPaPJe32Kc8ZpNbXOcl4ivqzFVrRRIKDFEvld8OCtwWYi67ADDyNUqw)



---

### Popular Kanban Tools

- **Digital Platforms:** Trello, Jira, Notion, Asana, Monday.com , and ClickUp for remote or distributed team collaboration.
- **Physical Boards:** Whiteboards with sticky notes, or specialized magnetic/glass kits like [pmxboard](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESxwEBxCJF19PzfW4-_gwCCVqk8nxvyIUsjWxT3z50QwiS232ZklB6BaOJrSN64qSLNu67ursgd03rZQdfcvVL7PKjxMGqyBYEzNgEb4ANqCs65cLTLcM_JuI5QNJy4Da-555nABTflXUW-EyDLyDzo17jbu5juqS7nU_yw5AgYN9nRzYqlBaSC14bklhEjX0ZHXIR0kESKL5lwxkdtR0ue0yfB5GEPJgnDGWg86AMUX-tTZcxO9vxlwrW3AeoEQQRrKvzEwdKD3-j) and [PATboard](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlAEBxCJF1028FjxeUhm6755k9s4jIEngzAn3Aunac9oD2vWTWYoZQKuTVhZJgy5ToO-FxZRIuQ43snaoS18n0jV24aLqsPN8uWJSV7tfwPUCAffaLxLYiR31pbW4-GjzJiHMTK4P-MpY1a4MsePEuNYHO0y_wTz8xz2lYLtxixrCN_3q1lRrRRngfrswvoKJHFYF4G1c) for office spaces or desk setups.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXXZS3bdrjEJ758PaxYUCXRACTRi_kIGKThTMy5bviw7goF0hF4H1pzqEwiDanyDZfUYmUHyXU3Dg3eU5Qj845xyPUZBcb7b_pqfXwjEkGJ04MwqnouI6WOCQUmf_zeHQaaBOc)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF15DYcFZnqS4glvj6klcgUajRmA9fTaTEa874LqIG_fJbAjZ6kvvjpq_fuZBEe5mDQ29R21pWjdwAK5wUWghfAmNw55k8l2tPEb6jCzjnt1upS9RD-BbaaeKZpx_2z3TykjAWuwnd6Mk8LHBtwqy2hNoOcbE8kA1HLgBxKA59rw)[[3]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:16416003330309308131,catalogid:12211583780525977977,gpcid:17968961813534409692,mid:576462439718054692&ibp=oshop)[[4]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:8853185502090238079,catalogid:11494679910088447189,gpcid:16539373155988672803&ibp=oshop)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXmT5eU5jEcSO3iIPCAhcfZbP5ILT1E4ntOYJ2JbalRpYoyCqRZe7YamA7yMr8MPqiqnGsbpCEyPdJ3T4t-gbV49LmPTLa2e_-YSU9MwuG6KfxTC_ziS-aCugGvxOTezupqNfsdmANRYypwwQ)

3. **Move Left to Right:** As a task progresses through production or review, slide its card across the columns until it reaches *Done*.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXXZS3bdrjEJ758PaxYUCXRACTRi_kIGKThTMy5bviw7goF0hF4H1pzqEwiDanyDZfUYmUHyXU3Dg3eU5Qj845xyPUZBcb7b_pqfXwjEkGJ04MwqnouI6WOCQUmf_zeHQaaBOc)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXmT5eU5jEcSO3iIPCAhcfZbP5ILT1E4ntOYJ2JbalRpYoyCqRZe7YamA7yMr8MPqiqnGsbpCEyPdJ3T4t-gbV49LmPTLa2e_-YSU9MwuG6KfxTC_ziS-aCugGvxOTezupqNfsdmANRYypwwQ)
4. **Inspect and Adapt:** Regularly review where cards stall (bottlenecks) and adjust workflow rules to improve speed and quality.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXXZS3bdrjEJ758PaxYUCXRACTRi_kIGKThTMy5bviw7goF0hF4H1pzqEwiDanyDZfUYmUHyXU3Dg3eU5Qj845xyPUZBcb7b_pqfXwjEkGJ04MwqnouI6WOCQUmf_zeHQaaBOc)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXwJUaBF-v-lBh9AUyfCdtBQdp54jxi7fw0E_E8wfH6yUcsS2Gi9JrJwPN0qk9g9cYFMQS3VLA6Kn84vEcsFoykczI1sN9igH3ZxjJpKLhArMlIljzT8Bw5evXciW8uDlnefoVwQk)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHEIkXX7jfz22NO3FDyDZJ-ECepJhELr2CJUr4jrTkN9jy43YxiHumxPQRnPk-C_iGTQ0eyWZbXPaPJe32Kc8ZpNbXOcl4ivqzFVrRRIKDFEvld8OCtwWYi67ADDyNUqw)
